ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Meets with campus section. This course includes online synchronous class sessions where students will meet online using the ?Go to Webinar? conferencing technology. Students will need a working external microphone/speakers or headset with microphone and reliable high-speed internet. Wireless Internet is not recommended. For more information about the course, other enrollment options and additional required educational material please go to http://online.ansci.illinois.edu/
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $380.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $347.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
